mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (member_id, board_type, title, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT board_id, member_id, board_type, title, content, view_num, board_status, created_at, updated_at FROM board

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board as b WHERE b.board_status = 'ACTIVE'
AND b.board_type = #{boardType}

SELECT b.*, m.*, COUNT(bl.board_like_id) as ln, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN bl.member_id = #{memberId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS ls FROM board as b LEFT JOIN member as m ON b.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN board_like as bl ON b.board_id = bl.board_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId} GROUP BY b.board_id
